meta.parties: Aliya Marikar Abuthahir v. Aliya Marikar Mohammed Sally

rules.statement: A deed of gift between Muslims can be valid under the general law even if it does not conform to Mohamedan law, provided that the terms of the deed are consistent with a transaction known and recognized by the general law.
rules.supporting_quote: "But if there are terms in it inconsistent with Mohamedan law, but known to and recognized by the general law, the inference is that it was not intended that there should be a valid gift as understood in the Mohamedan law. but that the donor intended to produce the particular transaction known to and recognized by the general law, and if he has produced it, effect will be given to the deed under that law."
